title: Root workspace Markdown context noise
acceptance: Root direct Markdown files classified; archive candidates moved only by strict safe rules; protected docs preserved; manifest emitted.

title: z.py scope creep risk
acceptance: No runtime/agent/schema semantics added to z.py; code and docs state z.py is operator-local certifier tooling.

title: Phase gates not enforced as blocking operator approvals
acceptance: P25 injection docs contain STOP/WAIT language; verifier fails stale IDs or missing gate language.

title: Stale P22/P23/P24 active instruction residue
acceptance: CURRENT_RUN.md, CODEX_RUN_INDEX.md, classification map, archival policy aligned to P25; no stale current-instruction entries.

title: Verifier lacks complete release-hygiene checks
acceptance: Verifier runs package validation, phase-gate integrity, root-md archive dry-run, support-profile truth checks, stale-run scans, cargo gates where available.

title: Support profile needs post-P25 truth convergence
acceptance: README, STATUS, SUPPORT_PROFILE, known limitations distinguish supported-local, fixture-backed, deferred-cloud, deferred-autonomy.

title: Large-file maintainability risk
acceptance: Containment plan emitted; no risky refactor unless needed for gates; split candidates and future tests specified.

title: P25 evidence manifest missing
acceptance: P25_STATUS_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json includes commands, hashes, moved files, test results, support claims, unresolved risk.

title: V10+ architecture must not contaminate P25 implementation
acceptance: V10+ remains design-only; no runtime geometry/federation/mechanism implementation in P25.

title: Claude audit must be absorbed explicitly
acceptance: Claude audit concerns mapped to P25 issue IDs and final report; unresolved items listed.

title: Parent worktree ambiguity
acceptance: Parent dirty state recorded as external limitation; AiDENs package claims bounded to package root and included siblings.
